release_notes: Build 90 makes Match archive faster by fingerprinting each project folder once per scan and caching verified folder fingerprints for repeated in-window rescans.
The matcher now walks project files once for file-size and JSON evidence instead of separately re-enumerating the same folder tree.

Exact stored folder name plus at least five same relative files with identical sizes now acts as a strong copy-identity anchor, outranking looser same-series/title candidates and resolving false ambiguities.
The stronger copy-identity rule keeps the same safety model: only one-to-one Exact/High matches become confident relink candidates, and genuine competing copies remain ambiguous.
Build 89 keeps the Quiz Archive Audit open and refreshes it in place after each relink.
Relinking changes Quiz History database paths only; existing C: folders remain untouched and no archive files are copied, moved, renamed, overwritten, or deleted.
Build 83 changes Full and Marathon quizzes to a 5-second default and adds safe post-upload archiving.
